title: HTTP 413 MaxUploadSizeExceededException on form submits after moving to Spring Boot 4
symptom: Submitting a multipart/form-data form with many fields gets HTTP 413 from the embedded server and the log shows MaxUploadSizeExceededException: Maximum upload size exceeded. The same form worked on Boot 3.5.
cause: Boot 4 applies the multipart size limits to the aggregate size of the whole request instead of per file, and Tomcat additionally limits how much of a rejected body it will swallow. A form with many parts adds up to more than the default 1MB request limit, so the request is cut off with 413.
fixSummary: Raise the limits: spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size=100MB and spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size=100MB, plus server.tomcat.max-swallow-size=-1 and server.tomcat.max-http-form-post-size=100MB. Restart and resubmit.
